links.outcome: F1 for extracting genome-informed clinical recommendations from EHR notes, validated against manual chart review
links.effect: Baseline F1 = 0.50-0.54; incorporating guideline knowledge improved F1 by 0.14-0.31 across models (pooled with RAG in the abstract)
links.quote: Incorporating guideline knowledge improved F1 by 0.14-0.31 across models, with LLaMA-3.1-8B using RAG achieving the highest performance (F1 = 0.81).
